title: The shrimp that punches like a bullet
caption:
Small animal, record-breaking punch.

Researchers filmed strikes at up to 5,000 frames per second and found the shrimp may use cavitation forces to damage hard-shelled prey.

Source: Patek, Korff & Caldwell 2004, Nature.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
